By fostering an inclusive and informed student body, we seek to empower individuals to become active defenders of human rights and agents of meaningful change.

name: Cornell Anglers' Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience, Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of Cornell Anglers’ Society (CAS) is to promote sustainable fishing practices, educate others on fishing/fishery conservation, and create a family-like community. It aims to provide a diverse environment for members dedicated to fishing, aquatic life, and their sustainability.

name: Cornell Anime Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Cornell Anime Club is an independent, student-run organization founded at and affiliated with Cornell University. It was established in the spring of 1988 by Masaki Takai (’91) and Kay Lillibridge (’92). The purpose of the Cornell Anime Club (formerly the Cornell Japanese Animation Society) is to spread our love of Japanese animation and to allow fans to celebrate and expand their interest in the medium as a community.

name: Cornell Anti-Detention Alliance Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Cornell Anti-Detention Alliance, affiliated with the Feminist, Gender, and Sexuality Studies Program at Cornell, supports detained and previously detained immigrants through direct services and grassroots advocacy. We demand a humane immigration system that does not exploit and incarcerate immigrants, in Upstate New York and beyond. Our team will conduct virtual visitation with and provide direct social services for migrants detained at ICE detention facilities (facilitate their access to resources, support services, legal services) We will also engage in political advocacy by spreading awareness about the immigrant detention system, organizing with statewide and national campaigns for immigrant justice, and fundraising for migrants in need of financial support. ÔåÆ we plan on involving the community through direct education and advocacy campaigns

name: Cornell Antitrust Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Law School
description: The purpose of Cornell Antitrust Club shall be to provide a platform for students to gain exposure to the field of antitrust law.

name: Cornell Architecture Student Practice Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: College of Architecture Art and Planning
description: To give students experience in an architecture firm structure and give them the opportunity to work on infrastructure and design projects that will build their desired skills. Bonus purpose is to provide Cornell Students the opportunity to design infrastructure projects that can be built around campus.

name: Cornell Artificial Intelligence Investments club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, AFFILIATION: Dyson School
description: The purpose of CAIIC is to bring together students interested in the intersection of artificial intelligence and finance, providing opportunities to learn, research, and apply concepts in investing, data-driven decision-making, and AI applications in financial markets.

name: Cornell Astronomical Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of our organization is to: 1) Unite the people at Cornell who are fascinated by astronomy, stargazing, and/or the night sky. 2) Run weekly public stargazing nights at Fuertes Observatory. 3) Provide the opportunity for the public and club members to learn more about astronomy and stargazing. 4) Teach club members how to use our telescopes and become better stargazers.

name: Cornell Autonomous Motions
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: Cornell Autonomous Motions Team (CAM) is dedicated to advancing autonomous technology by developing intelligent machines that enhance Human-Robot Interaction (HRI). Our mission is to design, build, and innovate autonomous systems capable of adaptive decision-making, and dynamic interaction with humans, paving the way for the future of robotics and automation.

name: Cornell Aviation Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: The mission of this organization is to cultivate a community of students who are interested in aviation, from those who already have a pilot's license to those who just think planes are cool. We provide students with the opportunity to explore the world of aviation through learning opportunities, connections to industry leaders, and tangible experiences with flying. We have events throughout each semester, including club meetings, events at the Ithaca Airport (e.g. visiting the East Hill Flying Club to learn about being a private pilot, a tour of the control tower, etc.), and aviation industry speakers.

name: Cornell Ballet Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of Cornell Ballet Club shall be to extend the opportunity of classical ballet technique to all Cornell students who seek to continue their artistic growth in this discipline, fostering a tight-knit and close community of talented ballerinas and ballet dancers. We are a student-led group that meets weekly to take ballet classes and learn variations and classical ballet repertoire, working on pieces for our semi-annual showcase.

name: Cornell Big Red Club Volleyball
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The Cornell Big Red Club Volleyball is a student-run organization at Cornell University for female athletes who wish to play competitive volleyball. Our mission is to provide a safe, fun environment. Practices are held biweekly and the ladies travel to other Colleges and Universities in the Northeast in order to participate in NWVCL tournaments.

name: Cornell Bioacoustics Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: Explore the fingerlakes region through sound, connecting people to the nature around us acoustically. We want to reach out between disciplines to make the acoustical world as accessible as possible and connect people of all pursuits: artists, engineers, scientists, and the local community to explore, celebrate, and share the nature that surrounds us.

name: Cornell BioVentures and Life Sciences Entrepreneurship Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The Cornell BioVentures and Life Sciences Entrepreneurship Club empowers students to turn Cornell’s scientific discoveries into real-world ventures. Partnering with the Center for Life Science Ventures and faculty innovators, we connect undergraduates and graduates with incubator companies, capital networks, and mentorship to accelerate biotech commercialization and cultivate the next generation of life sciences entrepreneurs.

name: Cornell Bitcoin Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Education/Human Services
description: The purpose of the Cornell Bitcoin Club shall be to contribute to fostering a global network of Bitcoin students, promoting education and collaboration and connecting students with opportunities and resources within the Bitcoin ecosystem. As Bitcoin is for every human, so is the Cornell Bitcoin Club.

name: Cornell Brawl Stars Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports
description: Brawl Stars is a popular mobile game that has been established ever since Dec 12, 2018. However, over the past few years (2024-2026), Brawl Stars saw a large increase in player base. Due to its increasing popularity, making a club where the people at Cornell can play Brawl Stars and find teammates makes sense. It is easily accessible since it is a free mobile game, our organization would allow people who enjoy playing to connect over this shared interest and make friends while also encouraging new players. While Brawl Stars is a game of skill, strategy is also very important for victory, so the club would also be a place where strategies can be exchanged.

name: Cornell Capital Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: (Through our rigorous 10-week new member education process, new members work on two case studies of successful startups. This process provides members with a deep understanding of how to obtain investment, manage finances, develop ideas, and drive company growth. In the final three weeks, students work with teammates to initiate and develop their own projects. Then, they pitch to successful investors associated with Cornell Capital Club, which is an exclusive opportunity available only to Cornell Capital Club members)

name: Cornell Chai Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Food/Drink
description: The mission of the Cornell Chai Club is to provide a platform for students to explore and appreciate the rich cultural traditions of tea from around the world, engage in meaningful discussions, and build lasting connections through shared experiences. We strive to promote relaxation, cultural exchange, and a deeper understanding of the art of tea-making.

name: Cornell Chapter of Partners in Health Engage
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: At Partners in Health, we believe healthcare is a universal human right. Around the world, we fight injustice by providing care first to those who need it most. We are a team of students committed to healthcare equity and community education around the importance of equitable healthcare systems through driven campaigns that build and direct power towards generating new resources, fostering public discourse, and advocating for effective policies that advance health care as a human right. We are fervently dedicated to advocacy for the federal funding and policy needed to support Partners in Health’s work and medical care delivery to underserved communities around the world. As a chapter of the national network of teams of PIH Engage, the organizing sector of Partners in Health with hundreds of chapters nationwide across universities and cities of the US, we draw from our national network of passionate community organizers and policy advocates to advocate for health equity in communities worldwide through local community building, education, and fundraising initiatives that strengthen PIH’s work providing high quality healthcare in the conviction that treatable illnesses should not be a death sentence for those in areas without accessible medical care. Through organizing community education centered events around global public health issues and rights-centered policies that strengthen healthcare infrastructure, we aspire to mobilize the Cornell community around the right to health and justice in public health. Through fundraising for care-delivery programs and community building campaigns around Partners in Health’s work across the calendar year, we strive to emphasize the tremendous impact of a grassroots approach to social justice work in global health, increase participation in health justice issues, and understanding around the importance of equitable access to public health resources in underserved communities both in the US and across the Global South.

name: Cornell Chinese Basketball Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Provide a platform for all Chinese students, scholars, and faculties who love basketball to foster friendships, enhance sportsmanship, and improve their games

name: Cornell Club Ice Hockey D2
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Our purpose is to increase the skill level of players dedicated to playing hockey at Cornell so that they may enjoy playing hockey at the collegiate level through a low time commitment. The organization competes at the Division II level of AAU College Hockey and practices twice a week throughout the season. The team may occasionally promote players to the AAU D1 Club Hockey team based on performance and/or need.

name: Cornell Club Rowing
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: We provide an opportunity for all past and new rowers a chance to get back on the water. The goal of the team is to foster discipline, focus, and friendship on and off the water.  We compete in various local regattas through the Cascadilla Boat Club (CBC). As a competitive team, hard work is expected.

name: Cornell Club Waterskiing
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: Cornell Club Waterskiing was created by a group of undergraduate Cornell students who share a love of being on the water and shredding on the ski! With help from Cornell University as well as some equipment donations from fellow enthusiasts, we hope to spread our love of Waterskiing to the Cornell community and the greater Ithaca area.

name: Cornell Coffee Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink
description: Coffee Club is founded on three tenants a.	Education: officers oversee lessons regarding the science, history, politics, economics, and social impact of coffee b.	Outreach: officers communicate with local organizations about opportunities for collaboration c.	Craft: officers oversee education regarding coffee brewing processes

name: Cornell Cognitive Science Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Departmental, Community Service, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Our mission is to build community for Cognitive Science majors and students interested in the mind and brain. We explore diverse fields—neuroscience, psychology, computer science, linguistics, philosophy, and more—by hosting social events, academic discussions, creative projects, and community service opportunities.

name: Cornell Commodity Trading Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson College of Business
description: To inform Cornell students about the commodity trading industry as a whole and explore the job opportunities within.

name: Cornell Consulting Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The mission of Cornell Consulting Club is to bring management consulting acumen and industry exposure to students of all levels and all backgrounds. The club has three main purposes: to teach its members the skills and tools fundamental in strategy consulting, to provide students with practical experience by working on projects with local, national and international businesses (and provide clients with top of the line services), and to bridge the gap between its members and the consulting industry through company visits and networking events.

name: Cornell Coptic Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Spiritual/Religious
description: The mission of establishing a Coptic Club on our college campus is rooted in the desire to create a nurturing and inclusive space for students of the Coptic faith and those interested in learning about it. Our mission is to foster a sense of community among Coptic Orthodox students, helping them strengthen their spiritual journeys, maintain their cultural heritage, and engage with the wider campus community. We aim to promote interfaith dialogue, understanding, and respect while serving as a resource for those seeking knowledge about the Coptic Orthodox tradition. Through our activities, events, and discussions, we aspire to uphold the core values of our faith and share its rich history, spirituality, and traditions with others. This club seeks to be a beacon of faith, culture, and unity, enriching the campus experience for all who join us.

name: Cornell Credit Literacy Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Cornell Credit Club aims to enhance students’ understanding of credit scores and personal financial literacy through practical education and peer collaboration. We empower members to build and manage their credit responsibly, develop lifelong financial habits, and gain confidence in navigating the financial systems that shape their futures. By fostering awareness and accessibility, we strive to create a more financially informed Cornell community.

name: Cornell Data Strategy Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: The purpose of Cornell Data Strategy Club is to serve as a platform for students interested in merging data science with business consulting and finance.

name: Cornell Entertainment Engineering & Design Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Engineering
description: To inspire the next generation of entertainment innovators.

name: Cornell Equity Derivatives Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Cornell Equity Derivatives Club (CEDC) seeks to educate, empower, and connect students interested in the complex and rapidly evolving world of equity derivatives — including options, futures, and other structured products. Our mission is to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world application by fostering hands-on learning, professional development, and collaboration within Cornell’s finance community.

name: Cornell Ethics Bowl Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: Our mission as the Cornell Ethics Bowl shall be to foster collaborative discourse around contemporary ethical issues. The APPE "supports and trains the next generation of ethics faculty and professionals, works to improve ethical conduct in our communities and workplaces, and advances public dialogue in ethics and values."

name: Cornell Fanworks Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports, Visual Arts
description: The Cornell Fanworks Club seeks to provide an open, inclusive, and collaborative space for creating and discussing all types of fanworks including, but not limited to, fanfiction, fanart, fan videos, and cosplay. Creators and consumers of fanworks from all fandoms are welcome and encouraged to participate.

name: Cornell Filipino Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: 1. To promote and protect the interest of the Filipino community. 2. To promote awareness of Filipino values and culture within the community and CFA. 3. To foster unity and friendship among its members. 4. To promote friendship and cooperation with other organizations and entities.

name: Cornell Financial Analysts Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: CFA is formed with the vision to give students the opportunity to further their education in the finance industry, ultimately being able to secure employment. CFA will expose its members to a proprietary 10-week education series focused on financial services interview preparation, real-world professionals, and programs in order to enhance the learning experience. We welcome and encourage all students at Cornell to join the CFA community. We welcome and encourage all students at Cornell to join the CFA community. CFA will provide support, guidance, and the ability for students to collectively organize learning experiences for all members' interests. Our end goal is to create a platform where upperclassmen can give back to underclassmen that are looking to secure employment within financial services through education and mentorship.

name: Cornell FinTech Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: The Cornell FinTech Club (CFT) is the first all-encompassing, undergraduate-led fintech club that aims to create spaces and opportunities for students interested in fintech through weekly discussions, continuous education, and events such as hackathons, conferences, and corporate speakers.

name: Cornell Go Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Tabletop Games
description: "The Cornell Go Club is dedicated to promoting the study and enjoyment of the ancient strategic board game Go (also known as Weiqi in Chinese or Baduk in Korean). Our mission is to create a welcoming community where players of all skill levels, from complete beginners to experienced competitors, can learn, play, and appreciate the depth and beauty of the game. We host weekly meetings every Thursday from 7-11pm in Willard Straight Hall, offering friendly matches, teaching sessions, and casual tournaments. The Cornell Go Club aims to foster strategic thinking, cross-cultural understanding, and an enduring appreciation for one of humanity's oldest intellectual arts."

name: Cornell Golf Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of the Cornell Club Golf Team is to combine as a unit of competitive golfers in the Cornell community to grow in our appreciation and expertise of the game. The Cornell Golf Team will conform to the uniform system of handicapping and rules set forth by the United States Golf Association. The Club Golf Team will be committed to the traditions and history of the game and compete on a national level as members of the National Collegiate Club Golf Association.

name: Cornell Growth Capital Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Cornell Growth Capital Club is looking to mentor future generations of leaders in the financial industry specifically those who are looking to enter the field of growth capital. During our new member education process, we will provide hands-on experience through mock portfolios and mentorship to provide a basic understanding of the growth capital and the related fields of private equity, venture capital, credit, and investment banking. In addition, we hope to inspire and provide members with knowledge not only in the growth capital industry, but wherever your career takes them. In true Cornell fashion, the Cornell Growth Capital Club is looking to foster collaboration and empower our members to make positive changes and drive development in the world of growth capital.

name: Cornell Hedge Fund Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Business and Management
description: Through real-world investing experience, ongoing education, and mentorship, we seek to provide students with the opportunities to develop their skills and interests in finance, regardless of their background. We are committed to our foundational values of integrity, innovation, and diversity to sustain an atmosphere that maximizes our members' personal and professional growth.

name: Cornell Horn Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: To share the beautiful sound of all brass instruments with the Cornell community.

name: Cornell ICPC Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: Cornell ICPC Club is Cornell's official competitive programming team. Every year, we participate in the International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC) and organize training sessions to help team members improve their problem-solving and algorithmic thinking skills.

name: Cornell International Finance Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of Cornell International Finance Club shall be to empower students to explore global markets, develop financial expertise, and connect with industry professionals, fostering cross-cultural understanding and preparing members for impactful careers in international finance.

name: Cornell Investments Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of Cornell Investments Club shall be to provide a comprehensive and generalist investment education that covers all facets of the finance industry. Our aim is to equip members with a broad understanding of investment strategies and financial principles, enabling them to navigate the complexities of various financial markets.

name: Cornell Latine Policy Forum
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Political/Speech/Debate, AFFILIATION: Brooks School
description: The Cornell Latine Policy Forum unites undergraduate, graduate, and Ph.D. students who are dedicated to examining how public policy and administration can advance equity and inclusion for Latine communities. We provide a space for discussion, research, and collaborative learning that connects academic perspectives with the lived experiences of Latine populations across local, national, and global contexts.

name: Cornell Latinos in Business Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of Cornell Latinos in Business (CLB) Club shall be to provide Latino students and students interested in LatAm at Cornell University with the necessary resources and opportunities to succeed in a career in business through comprehensive education and community. The organization will honor Cornell University's broader mission of ‘Any Person, Any Study’ by allowing anyone interested in business to apply.

name: Cornell Mafia Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports, Tabletop Games
description: We hold weekly meetings for the purpose of playing Mafia, a role-playing game that blends logic and psychology with a twist of mystery. A dynamic conflict between an uninformed majority and a hidden, well-informed minority—and often, third parties with their own chaotic goals. Games are moderated by members brave enough to put their game design to the test. Membership is free and easy: just show up! 9PM Fridays at the Keeton House downstairs lounge (near the dining hall).

name: Cornell Malaysian Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: COMSA is an association that conducts activities to promote esprit de corps among Malaysian students at Cornell.

name: Cornell Marketing Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Cornell Marketing Club aims to help students with their professional careers by demonstrating the relevance of marketing and strategy in every aspect of the business world.

name: Cornell Matcha Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of Cornell Matcha Club is to bring the Cornell community together through a shared love of matcha and conversation. At each meeting, we will share traditional matcha, as well as the history and traditions of matcha.

name: Cornell Medical Brigade Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The proposed objective for this club is to equip and provide pre-med students and their peers with the necessary resources, skills and opportunities to make a significant and meaningful impact in a country that lacks adequate healthcare facilities. This organization will not only assist those in need, but also provide hands-on experience (under the supervision of the national chapter) for students to immerse themselves into their future profession. This will enable students to have a deep understanding of the challenges of the healthcare system and the complexities of providing medical care in resource-limited environments.

name: Cornell Men's Club Basketball
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: To provide students with a fun and competitive environment to play basketball, and compete against local and national competition.

name: Cornell Men's Volleyball Performance and Development Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The Men’s Volleyball Performance & Development Club at Cornell was created to expand access to organized, high-level men’s volleyball for students who are passionate about the sport but not currently part of the travel A/B teams. Each year, over 35–40 students try out for the existing club, with fewer than 5 earning roster spots—leaving many experienced and motivated athletes without a structured environment to continue improving. This organization fills that gap by providing a comprehensive training and performance program focused on skill development, athletic preparation, and internal competition. Through weekly position-specific labs, guided scrimmages, performance and injury-prevention training, and video/analytics sessions, members will strengthen their technique, decision-making, and teamwork. The club will also offer opportunities for the broader Cornell community to participate in tournaments and clinics, fostering engagement across all skill levels. Our goal is to provide determined, developing players with a more effective environment to improve, while complementing the existing travel teams—creating a deeper, more sustainable pipeline for Cornell men’s volleyball and ensuring that every athlete has the opportunity to train, compete, and grow.

name: Cornell Mergers & Acquisitions Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of Cornell Mergers and Acquisitions Club shall be to expand students' understanding of the legal and financial complexities concerning the mergers and acquisitions process.

name: Cornell Nuclear is Clean Energy Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: Our mission is to raise awareness about nuclear power being a clean energy that can largely benefit decarbonization goals and eventually start including nuclear engineering and nuclear energy policy courses in Cornell’s curriculum.

name: Cornell Organization for Labor Action
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of the Cornell Organization for Labor Action shall be to advance economic and workplace justice through collective, non-hierarchical organizing. We support and engage in the global struggle for labor rights, from efforts on our campus to those across the world. We foster solidarity between students and workers and advocate for systemic change toward economic justice through education and activism.

name: Cornell Origami Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Visual Arts
description: The purpose of Cornell Origami Club shall be to practice folding techniques, foster community, and cultural appreciation through the ancient art of origami.

name: Cornell Partners in Expansion & Capital Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson College of Business
description: CPEC aims to cultivate a dynamic and innovative community where aspiring finance professionals can engage deeply with the world of private equity. Our mission is to provide our members with unparalleled educational experiences, hands-on investment opportunities, and strategic networking platforms.

name: Cornell Pharmaceutical Outreach Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: The purpose of Cornell Pharmaceutical Outreach Club shall be to bring pharmaceutical industry leaders to campus through our outreach efforts and educate students on the drug development process, financial obligations of pharmaceutical companies, and opportunities that may exist within the industry for students across a wide variety of studies.

name: Cornell Physical Intelligence Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: Our mission is to conduct rigorous, interdisciplinary research in physical artificial intelligence, with a focus on intelligent robotics systems. We aim to study how mechanical design, electrical systems, and artificial intelligence converge in the development of novel robotic systems that "think" through their bodies.

name: Cornell Pickleball Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The Cornell Pickleball Club is dedicated to fostering a vibrant and inclusive community where students, faculty, and staff of all skill levels can come together to enjoy the sport of pickleball. We aim to create a welcoming environment that encourages sportsmanship, personal growth, and a lifelong love for the game.

name: Cornell Pogo Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: Our mission is to spread the joy, creativity, and athletic challenge of pogo sticking across the Cornell community. We aim to build an inclusive space where students of all skill levels — from first-time jumpers to advanced trick riders — can learn, train, and innovate together.

name: Cornell Pokémon ACE Trainers Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Tabletop Games
description: The purpose of Cornell Pokémon ACE Trainers shall be to organize and host Pokemon related events on Cornell grounds to create an accessible environment available to interested students. This organization achieves this hosting related events centered on the Pokemon Trading Card Game (TCG), Video Game Championship (VGC), Pokemon GO, and trading to allow members to collaborate with peers through casual play, tournaments, and trading. These activities offer students opportunities to connect, compete, and deepen knowledge of Pokemon.

name: Cornell Poker Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports
description: The mission of Cornell Poker Club is to provide undergrads with opportunities to learn, play, and master the exciting game of poker through meetings, social events, and tournaments. We also hope to promote diversity and inclusion to make poker available to all.

name: Cornell Policy Group
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: Cornell Policy Group is a non-partisan student-run think tank that engages college students in policy research, writing, and local advocacy.

name: Cornell Political Union
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: To provide Cornell a forum for the bipartisan debate and parliamentary discussion of political topics; to periodically publish bipartisan policy proposals and/or resolutions incorporating the findings of the debate and parliamentary discussion; to reduce hyper-partisanship through the thoughtful incorporation and acceptance of all political ideologies, and by the perseverance of strict neutrality by the Union's leadership; to sponsor events to promote the political education of the members and the Cornell community.

name: Cornell Roundnet
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: This organization is designed for the dual purpose of introducing new players to the game of Spikeball and connecting experienced players with others of similar skill levels. Even for students who have never heard of or seen Spikeball before, we aim to teach everything we know: the rules, the basics of play, and more advanced moves and tactics when appropriate. For us, Spikeball has provided countless afternoons and evenings of fun and we hope to share that with the rest of the Cornell community!

name: Cornell Russian Language Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The mission of the Russian Language Society at Cornell is to provide a safe space for cross-cultural exchange using the Russian language as a medium for communication. Members will connect with each other through the cooking of our traditional dishes and celebration of cultural holidays. In addition, we hope to help members connect more deeply with their cultures by showcasing films, reading books, and playing games all in our native language.

name: Cornell SoLyra JPop Dance Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: SoLyra is Cornell’s only Japanese Pop (JPop) dance group. We strive to build a welcoming community where students can explore JPop dance inspired by anime and idol culture, develop performance and production skills, and share their passion through dance covers, media content, and live showcases. Our mission is to celebrate and spread JPop culture across the Cornell campus and the local community, offering all interested members opportunities to participate in regular practices and perform in events throughout the year.

name: Cornell Storm Chaser's Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: The purpose of the Cornell Storm Chasers shall be to increase our awareness and knowledge about meteorology outside the classroom, become active participants in the National Weather Service Skywarn program, expand diversity both within and outside of the Department of Atmospheric Science, and offer immediate relief if necessary. This will be achieved through monthly general meetings, bi-weekly instructional meetings on radar technology, field safety, and forecasting, occasional professional guest speakers, and field missions during breaks from instruction to practice and participate in data collection.

name: Cornell Strategy Solutions Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The goal of the club is to make consulting resources available to all Cornell students and draw from the rich and diverse experiences of the student body.

name: Cornell Student Athletes for Sustainability
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Sustainability/Environmental
description: The mission of this organization is to build a strong community of student-athletes who simultaneously develop a sense of awareness and active responsibility surrounding sustainability in athletics and beyond. Through student-led projects, integration of sustainable practices, and acts of community service, we aim to help mitigate climate change and other environmental issues our world faces. name: Cornell Supper Club

Members gain knowledge of networking, presentation, and financial analysis skills that are applicable to careers in and out of finance—pre-professional yet also pre-life.

category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming

name: Cornell Undergraduate Animal Behavior Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Departmental, PROF: Science/Healthcare, Animals/Wildlife

name: Cornell Undergraduate Research Board
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare

name: Cornell Undergraduate Research Journal
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: To provide a platform for Cornell undergraduate students to showcase their exemplary scholarly work to the student body and general public, and to offer the student body a wide range of academic perspectives, provoking intellectual pursuits and collaboration.

category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: The Cornell Undergraduate Research Magazine (CURM) is a magazine written and published by undergraduates, featuring profiles of student researchers from across the Cornell campus. CURM highlights how Cornell students extend their academic interests beyond the classroom. Regular columns include a look at research by a graduate student, a faculty member, and an alum. The vision of CURM is to provide student researchers with a platform to humanize their research and broadcast it to a general readership.

name: Cornell Undergraduate Sports & Entertainment Law Society Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Law
description: Foster meaningful dialogue between law students and undergraduates through shared programming and mentorship. Connect students with professionals in sports and entertainment law through speaker events and networking opportunities. Expose members to the breadth of the industry and help them build familiarity with its challenges and career paths. Build a supportive community of students who share an interest in the intersection of law, sports, and entertainment. Provide members with a platform to research, write, and share perspectives on key issues shaping the field.

name: Cornell Undergraduate Turkish Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: TSA is a student organization that aims to foster the Turkish community at Cornell via several activities, to provide a platform through which we can seek support and guidance, to ask some advice for our daily and academic life, to meet new people, and socialize. In short, the TSA exists to create a community and maximize the joy of the time we have here.

name: Cornell Underrepresented Students in Physics Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Make Cornell physics a more welcoming space, and promote diversity in physics.

name: Cornell Unicef Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Cornell UNICEF chapter organizes on Cornell campus to advocate for an equitable world for every child. We won't stop upholding the rights of all children and empowering every child everywhere.

name: Cornell United Football Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Cornell United Football Club - United in Diversity, Committed to Excellence Our mission is to foster a supportive soccer community, celebrating the diversity of our players and embracing camaraderie and fun. Beyond the field, we cherish the bonds that unite us as friends and teammates, creating an inclusive environment where personal growth flourishes. Committed to excellence and sportsmanship, we seek success in every match while understanding the significance of shared experiences. Our love for the beautiful game fuels our drive to improve, pushing us to represent Cornell University at regional and national tournaments. With 2-3 weekly practices on campus, we hone our skills and build a strong team dynamic. We embrace the joy of competition and cherish the connections that make each season memorable. Cornell United F.C. exemplifies Cornell's commitment to diversity, unity, and excellence. We aim to build upon past achievements, leaving a lasting legacy that reflects the true spirit of our united club. Together, we embrace challenges and cherish the moments that unite us in our passion for soccer.

name: Cornell University Computational Biology Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: Our mission is to empower students by providing resources, mentorship, and collaborative opportunities that build the skills and knowledge necessary to apply data-driven solutions to biomedical challenges. Through fostering an inclusive and interdisciplinary community, CU BMI equips students to translate their interests into real-world impact.

name: Cornell University Parole Initiative Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: We strive to foster relationships between people in prison and volunteers as a way to educate the community regarding the inner-workings of the criminal legal system and challenge traditional hierarchies of privilege and power. We also strive to promote relationships that are collaborative, meaningful, and long-lasting, and that are guided by principles of solidarity, self-determination, and love.

name: Cornell University Slackers Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: The purpose of Cornell Slackers Club shall be to present slacklining to the Cornell community, and provide a space for like-minded individuals to collaborate and improve their skills.

name: Cornell UX Design Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: To create a centralized community for UX/product designers at Cornell to learn and grow together both professionally and socially, and to demystify parts of the product design journey and bring designers together.

name: Cornell Venture and Entrepreneurship Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Our mission is to create a broad-based Cornell community for entrepreneurship and investments that educates future venture capitalists and entrepreneurs and fosters the growth of new startups.

name: Cornell Wall Street Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, PROF: Business and Management
description: The Wall Street Club at Cornell is built on the belief that opportunity should come from ambition, not from exclusivity. Our mission is to give every student, regardless of prior background, an open door to learn finance and investment banking in an environment defined by collaboration, mentorship, and hands-on experience. Unlike traditional selective clubs that focus primarily on networking, we focus on learning. Students choose us, not the other way around. We believe that anyone with curiosity and dedication deserves the chance to explore the world of finance and discover their own potential within it. Through our Investment Banking Educational Program, Interview Preparation initiatives, and mentorship from industry professionals and alumni, we provide a structured pathway from foundational understanding to internship and full-time success. Our global connections include both U.S. and European investment banks, reflecting the international spirit of Cornell and the ambitions of our members. Together, we aim to build a community where future financiers grow side by side, not as competitors, but as teammates.

name: Cornell Weed Science Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Departmental
description: The Cornell Weed Club is a student-led group dedicated to exploring the science and practice of weed management. Our mission is to bring together students who share an interest in weeds, herbicides, and sustainable agriculture, and to create a space where we can learn from each other, faculty, and professionals in the field. We meet regularly to discuss new research and technologies in weed science, learn how to identify weeds and herbicide injury symptoms, and prepare for the annual Northeastern Weed Science Society Weed Contest. The club also plans to organize guest lectures and workshops led by Cornell Weed Science faculty to help students gain deeper insights into current research and practical applications. In addtion, the club will aid in mantaining Cornell University's Weed Science Teaching Garden which includes more than 125 different agricultral weed species.

name: Cornell's Chapter of The Diabetes Link
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: "Our mission – which drives each of us, every day – is to empower young adults with diabetes by providing access to the peer support, connections, and expert resources they need to thrive." We want to bring this community to Cornell!

name: Cross-Cultural Adoptee Mentorship Program
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: Cross-Cultural Adoptee Mentorship Program (C-CAMP) is a student-run outreach program of the David M. Einhorn Center for community engagement. We were founded in 2007 and promote cultural understanding and appreciation of internationally-adopted youth in Tompkins County. To do so, we match Cornell students with cross-culturally adopted mentees who share the same culture and heritage. The mentor-mentee pairings develop sustainable relationships that allow for a mutual exploration of their cultural identities. We also organize outreach events throughout the academic year to integrate our mission of education and cultural growth with the broader community. Our program is funded in part by the Student Assembly Finance Commission (SAFC) and the ALANA Intercultural Board.

name: East African Students Together

We showcase the rare talents and exotic instruments of musicians to encourage student growth beyond the standard curriculum.

Our mission is to inspire climate action and sustainable practices by harnessing the power of art to evoke emotion, spark dialogue, and drive change. Through workshops, exhibitions, and collaborative projects, we aim to equip the Cornell community with creative tools for a more sustainable future.

name: Economics Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: Johnson College of Business
description: Cornell Economics Society strives to provide economics students with the resources necessary to achieve their academic and professional goals. Beyond the economics major, we intend to foster a welcoming environment and make economics more accessible to students from all backgrounds. Finally, we seek to encourage students to integrate economics in life and discourse outside of the academic realm.

name: Empowering Women In Law

The organization seeks to provide a supportive environment for undergraduate women interested in law to connect, while providing opportunities for mentorship, professional development, networking, and educational resources, to support and empower the next generation of female leaders in law.

name: End Overdose Chapter at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing
description: We believe it is the fundamental right of every student, regardless of their background or economic status, to have costless access to harm reduction and health products. Such is aligned with the mission of Cornell Health, who emphatically strives “To foster lifelong learning and well-being through innovative services...” This club aims to provide the Cornell community with harm reduction tools, training, and awareness to ensure protection against overdose at social functions and other places on campus, at no charge. We aim to have a trained individual in all parts of campus, from Greek Life to on-campus housing. Through preventative measures, and an appropriately equipped campus community, we believe we can end overdose on campus.

name: Energy Transition Club at Cornell

description: We watch, critique, and appreciate films from around the world. Join us every Friday at 7:30 PM in the Schwartz Film Forum for weekly screenings and discussions. No experience is necessary to join!

name: Finance Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Since our inception, Cornell Finance Club has been focused on providing our members the skills and connections to navigate the financial services industry. We partner with numerous financial services firms through corporate-sponsored stock pitches as well as club-exclusive networking sessions.

name: First Generation Investors at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of First Generation Investors at Cornell shall be to teach high school students the power of saving and investing, preparing them for a successful financial future.

name: First Ithaca Chinese Christian Church
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Spiritual/Religious
description: The purpose of the FICCC English ministry is "to develop humble servants who will love the Lord, the lost and the local church for the rest of their lives".

name: First Love at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: To spread the love of Christ to the Cornell University community, fostering Christian fellowships, training leaders, and teaching the Word of God, with commitment and respect to all.

name: Food and Beverage Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink
description: Food & Beverage Society's (FBS) mission is to provide students with a structured and practical educational experience that focuses on the industry application that foundational classes set at Cornell. Additionally, FBS will provide students with the opportunity to network with seasoned alumni, connect with world class faculty at Cornell and contribute to the local community. The Food & Beverage Society will unite students, alumni in industry, and community leaders with a passion for innovation surrounding the food and beverages space.

name: Food Recovery Network at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Food/Drink
description: The Food Recovery Network promotes social welfare and attentive food-use by re-directing extra foodstuffs from Cornell's dining facilities to local food pantries. The focus of our group is to ensure that lower income areas have a dependable supply of nutritious meals. Our organization bridges Cornell and Ithaca providing an opportunity for students and locals to work together in shared commitment to fight hunger and reduce waste.

name: Footvolley at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of Footvolley shall be to play and promote the sport of footvolley through practices and competing in tournaments throughout the United States.

name: Forte Campus at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Mission:  To build a supportive community for Cornell undergraduate women where they can develop personal and professional skills through education, mentorship, and networking resources. Core Values:  We value empowering women to pursue their diverse interests and foster new relationships through learning in every facet of life, whether it be personal or professional.  We strive to create a supportive, open-minded, intimate community of motivated women, who are inspired to give back to the organization.

name: Founders Association At Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of the Founders Association At Cornell shall be to honor and celebrate the visionaries and pioneers whose unwavering commitment and dedication gave birth to our beloved institution, Cornell University. Our mission is to ensure that the legacy, contributions, and stories of our founders are preserved, acknowledged, and perpetuated for generations to come.

name: Friends of Médecins Sans Frontières Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose/philosophy of this organization is to raise awareness for the need of humanitarian efforts and garner support in order to provide help for those in need all across the globe, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, or political beliefs.

name: Future Civilizations Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Software/Coding/Programming, Sustainability/Environmental
description: We seek to envision the world that will follow the age of automation before it arrives. We aim to create an interdisciplinary community at Cornell where engineers, designers, social scientists, and artists collaborate to imagine the next evolution of civilization: cities that are intelligent, equitable, and deeply human in the age of autonomy.

name: Gaming at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports
description: The purpose of Gaming at Cornell shall be to promote all forms of gaming for members of Cornell. These forms of gaming can include game design, esports, casual video games, board games, and other categories up to the discretion of the eboard.

name: Generative AI at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: Our mission is to lead the exploration and innovation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs) at Cornell, with a focus on transforming the educational landscape. We envision building an inclusive and forward-thinking community where students collaborate to integrate these advanced AI technologies into educational tools, enhancing learning experiences and accessibility. By engaging in cutting-edge AI projects, we aim to apply generative AI and LLMs in practical, real-world educational settings, while fostering a culture of mentorship, continuous learning, and shared knowledge.

name: Georgian Students Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The mission of the Georgian Students Society shall be to bring together Georgian students at Cornell University to share and celebrate Georgian culture, foster a sense of belonging, and promote cross-cultural understanding through educational and social initiatives.

name: Ghanaians at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Ghanaians at Cornell is a cultural community that strives to share the Ghanaian culture with the Cornell and Ithaca communities. We provide a home away from home. We are a small Ghana.

name: Gift of Life Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: Gift of Life Cornell University raises awareness for the bone marrow donation process. In collaboration with the Gift of Life, one of the nation's public bone marrow and blood stem cell┬áregistries, Gift of Life Cornell University organizes events, campaigns, trainings, and seminars to register new potential donors, raise monetary funds, and educate the community about the bone marrow donation process. Gift of Life Cornell University is dedicated to expanding the bone marrow registry and supporting those who have been affected by the cancer experience.

name: Global China Connection at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: GCC is a professional development organization at Cornell University. We are a family of highly-motivated students that is part of a global collegiate network of over 60 chapters dedicated to foster deep and trusting personal relationships both with our current members and accomplished alumni.

name: Global Impact at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Global Impact at Cornell (GIC) is a student-led organization dedicated to advancing health equity through direct service, education, and global partnerships. GIC connects Cornell students with meaningful, hands-on opportunities to support underserved communities both locally and internationally, focusing on sustainable solutions in public health, clean water access, and renewable energy. By collaborating with established nonprofit partners and engaging students in service-based learning, GIC fosters cultural humility, social responsibility, and leadership rooted in compassion and action.

name: Global Medical Missions Alliance
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious, Health/Wellbeing
description: Global Medical Missions Alliance (GMMA) is a Christian organization that mobilizes and networks mission-minded healthcare professionals to serve as mentors to the next generation of healthcare professionals on medical mission trips.

name: Global Research & Consulting Group Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, PROF: Business and Management
description: The purpose of Global Research Consulting Group Cornell Chapter shall be to help socially-oriented organizations bring meaningful global change. Our consultants are top students from Cornell University, trained specifically to understand how to tackle nonprofits’ and social impact organizations’ biggest challenges.

name: GlobeMed at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: GlobeMed is a student-run nonprofit that creates long-term partnerships between university chapters and grassroots health organizations in developing countries to strengthen the movement for global health and social justice. Founded in the fall of 2010, GlobeMed at Cornell University is a sustainable global health organization that partners with a AMMID, Asociacion Maya-Mam de Investigacion y Desarrollo, in Comitancillo, San Marcos, Guatemala. Our projects take a holistic health approach, including environmental and nutritional implications and influence on locals' health. Our chapter has about 100 active staff members and is managed by an executive board. We, the chapter members, work together with AMMID to implement long-term initiatives to better the health community members in Comitancillo. Throughout the year GlobeMed at Cornell hosts educational events on campus, raises funds for our projects with AMMID, works on-site in Guatemala through organized internships during winter or summer breaks, learns to think critically about global health, and trains passionate leaders committed to realizing a world with equity in health. Mission: GlobeMed aims to strengthen the movement for global health equity by empowering students and communities to work together to improve the health of people living in poverty around the world.

name: Grub Ventures
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Our mission is to empower changemakers by introducing venture capital fundamentals, collaborating with impactful organizations, and evaluating companies through the lens of sustainable finance. **To join us, please head to cornellgrubventures.com

name: Guac Magazine
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: To bring and deliver the diverse beauty of our world to the palms of our readers and to facilitate meaningful exchanges between people of diverse backgrounds.

name: Guiding Eyes at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Animals/Wildlife
description: Our mission at Guiding Eyes at Cornell is to bridge Cornell students with Guiding Eyes for the Blind, and to increase awareness of raising guide dogs amongst the greater Cornell and Ithaca community.

name: Gymnastics Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The Cornell Gymnastics Club aims to provide an avenue whereby interested members of the Cornell community may train and compete in the sport of gymnastics. In doing so, we seek to facilitate an inclusive, safe, and educational environment that welcomes members of any gender or skill level. Finally, we hope to provide an organized supporting structure for our members and promote the sport of gymnastics at Cornell.

name: Habitat for Humanity Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Habitat for Humanity Cornell Chapter supports the Habitat for Humanity of Tompkins and Cortland Counties affiliate by connecting student volunteers with building opportunities with the local Habitat affiliate. Additionally, our organization aims to raise awareness about the importance of safe homes for underserved populations, and to fundraise for our local Habitat for Humanity chapter. Our organization also aims to advocate for affordable homeownership, aligning with Habitat's overarching mission.

name: Haitian Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of the Haitian Students Association is to promote cultural awareness and depict Haitian history and culture through activities within Cornell and the surrounding communities.

name: Hangovers at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Our purpose is to bring a variety of music to Cornell as well as across the world.  We strive for musical excellence in every one of our endeavors.  We hope to represent Cornell's finest when we perform on campus and strive to be ambassadors of music to Cornell as we travel around the world.

name: Hawaii Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The Cornell Hawai'i Club is a cultural/social organization whose purpose is two-fold.  First, we are here to welcome new and current students from Hawai'i and provide them with a network of other Hawai'i students in the Cornell and Ithaca areas. Second, we share the Hawaiian culture with the Cornell and Ithaca communities. The Hawai'i club completes these tasks through various events: spam musubi making nights, BBQ's, winter clothes shopping trips, and in the spring we put on a Lū'au! The club is not exclusive to students from Hawai'i; we include anyone who is interested in our beautiful home and wants to be included in the fun.

name: Health Education and Awareness Raising Together
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing
description: Health Education and Awareness Raising Together (HEART) aims to educate middle and high school students on health topics beyond their standard school curriculum. By doing so, we hope to instill knowledge and interest in improving their personal and the greater community's health and wellbeing.

name: Healthcare Review at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: The Cornell Healthcare Review is a student-led publication that explores recent developments and quandaries in medicine and healthcare. We feature articles written and published by undergraduate students, graduate students, and healthcare professionals from any academic institution.

name: Hearsay A Cappella
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Hearsay A Cappella is one of Cornell's premier all-female a cappella groups. Founded in 2000 as an alternative group, they pride themselves on an expansive repertoire spanning a wide variety of genres. Hearsay's most recent release, Objection, is an album that encompasses songs by Lady Gaga, Max Schneider, Rihanna, and more! With the love for music and love for one another as the defining factors for the group, Hearsay strives to create adventurous arrangements, deliver entertaining performances to Cornellians and the community, and foster a bond between Hearsayers through friendship, soup, and the color purple.

name: Hellenic Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The purpose of the Hellenic Student Association is to provide a space for Hellenes, students of Greek or Cypriot descent, or students interested in appreciating and learning about Hellenistic culture and heritage.

name: Herpetological Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Animals/Wildlife, Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of Herpetological Society at Cornell is to connect students who are interested in reptiles and amphibians with each other, herpetological research, and the larger community. Additionally, we aim to spread awareness and information about reptiles, amphibians, and conservation through outreach events with local communities.

name: Hillel at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: To enrich Jewish student life on campus.

name: Hindu Student Council
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Spiritual/Religious
description: The main purpose of our organization is to provide an environment for students to learn more about Hindu culture. We promote this idea by hosting regular religious events and discussions about spirituality and rituals. Another goal that the Hindu Student Council strives to achieve is to promote and participate in the practice of seva, or service. We do this by volunteering both on-and off-campus.

name: Hindu YUVA at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: Hindu YUVA (Youth for Unity, Virtues and Action) is an organization dedicated to the create a platform for students to explore and practice Hindu culture and way of life. We are a volunteer based organization which provides the Hindu youth across college campuses in the United States with a platform to practice, preserve, promote and protect Hindu dharma. Hindu YUVA Cornell chapter engages in various socio-cultural activities aiming at realization of this objective.

name: Historical European Martial Arts Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of Cornell HEMA shall be to facilitate Historical European Martial Arts study among the University's undergraduates. The club's main focus is in the German Longsword tradition, however, we are open to studying other weaponry and styles based on member interest. We shall facilitate manuscript-based study of techniques. However, we put the safety and health of our members before anything else. Therefore, a large portion of club activity will be dedicated to safety training and conditioning, and sparring will be done with feders (plastic swords).

name: Homelessness Action Project at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Homelessness Action Project at Cornell is a registered student organization committed to supporting local nonprofits and efforts that uphold the dignity and rights of individuals experiencing homelessness.

name: Hong Kong Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: To promote awareness and passion of Hong Kong culture through the organization of culturally related events.

name: Hopelessly Yellow at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Health/Wellbeing, Visual Arts
description: Founded at the University of Michigan in 2021, Hopelessly Yellow is a digital brand promoting mental wellness and positivity through writing, design, music, and media. Now at Cornell University, Hopelessly Yellow strives to foster a passionate community for all. More than just a club, Hopelessly Yellow embodies a blissful feeling, a fresh mindset, and a golden lifestyle.

name: HOSA - Future Health Professionals - Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: To empower HOSA-Future Health Professionals to become leaders in the global health community, through education, collaboration, and experience.

name: Humor Us! Sketch Comedy
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Humor Us! is a sketch comedy group at Cornell. We put on shows throughout the semester similar to episodes of Saturday Night Live. In fact, we are often confused with the cast of Saturday Night Live, so for future reference, we are the better looking ones. Members of Humor Us write, produce and act out all of our own material, and we love to share it with the Cornell community. Meet the group and watch some of our past shows at http://www.humoruscomedy.com.

name: Hydroponics at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: Cornell Hydroponics aims to bring together students with a passion for advancing agricultural technology through the use of hydroponics - growing crops in nutrient rich solution without soil.

name: Ignite
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The purpose of Ignite is to give people who identify and do not identify as Christian to give space to seek the meaning and theological basis of Christianity from a non-denominational and ecumenical lens.  We strongly believe that the best way to learn about Christianity is to actively participate in the customs and traditions performed. This will be well accomplished through a service.

name: Illuminations
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Illuminations is Cornell's co-ed undergraduate Chinese dance troupe dedicated to sharing Chinese culture by teaching and performing various styles of dance and original choreography. Illuminations performs numerous times throughout the year at a range of cultural events, culminating in an annual showcase during the spring semester.

name: ILR Black Student Union
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The ILR Black Student Union (ILR BSU) strives to foster solidarity between Black ILRies by providing a sense of community, academic resources, and a lifelong support network for all things work. The founding members have set a vision to enrich Black ILRies and the wider community through Black intellect and perspectives. We collectively stand against the injustices that Black workers face and are equally committed to advancing the initiatives and philosophy of all Black students in ILR.

name: ILR Women's Caucus
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, AFFILIATION: Dyson School
description: The purpose of the ILR Women's Caucus (ILRWC) is to work towards gender equality through open dialogues, professional development, and philanthropy and advocacy initiatives.

name: Impact Dance Troupe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Impact Dance Troupe is Cornell University's oldest dance troupe offering choreography and performance opportunities in ballet, modern, jazz, contemporary, hip-hop, tap, and more!  Each semester, members perform original choreography in Impact shows as well as a variety of benefit shows in collaboration with other campus organizations.  We are one of the only groups to have no dues, fees, or costs, and are an equal opportunity, student-run group.

name: Impact Investing at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Impact Investing at Cornell's mission is to provide a platform for undergraduate students to gain tangible experiences and insight into the impact investing field from the private equity scope. We aim to develop a network of future leaders in this sector through our Associate Development Program (ADP), events, and consulting project partnerships with established impact funds.

name: In Transcription Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: As the first step of gene expression, DNA is transcribed into mRNA. Having a similar goal, InT wants to become the transcription step that helps transform our community members into future leaders such as scientists, entrepreneurs, or investors that change the world with life science.

name: Independent Freedom Caucus
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: The purpose of the Independent Freedom Caucus shall be to promote and encourage conservative intellectualism and social cohesion. The Caucus provides a home for undergraduate conservative leaders and thinkers to earnestly seek truth through rigorous debate and lively social programming.

name: Indonesian Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Indonesian Association at Cornell aims to serve as a second home for the Indonesian community at Cornell University.

name: Indoor Drumline at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: The Cornell University Indoor Drumline aims to rehearse and perform a full-length indoor percussion show for several competitions within the New York State Percussion Circuit (NYSPC) during the course of the Spring semester.

name: Intellectual Property and Ethics Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The purpose of the Cornell Intellectual Property and Ethics Club (referred to hereafter as "CIPEC") shall be to provide students of Cornell University with an opportunity to learn about and engage with the complexities of Intellectual Property and the ethics associated with it. This engagement will be bolstered through research, debates, discussions, and presentations by club members and guest speakers.

name: Interdisciplinary Psychology Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Health/Wellbeing
description: Fostering and promoting an open, interdisciplinary platform for the science and application of psychology

name: International Affairs Review at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
