description: The Quiz Bowl Club provides an enjoyable, supplementary learning experience for Cornellians through the collective playing of quizbowl questions. We are primarily recreational, though the game is inherently competitive. We represent Cornell at quizbowl tournaments held at universities across the Northeast several times per semester, and usually send one or two teams to national competitions. For more information on college quizbowl, you can check out https://acf-quizbowl.com/. No prior experience is necessary to enjoy the game.

name: Rainy Day
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: Rainy Day is the longest running literary magazine on the Cornell University campus, publishing a biannual magazine presenting the finest student literary works to the widest audience possible.  We are a cooperative group of editors who critique work through interactive meetings.  Our staff members come from  myriad backgrounds: Economics, Biology, Philosophy, English and other majors.  We have been publishing for 50 years at Cornell and were founded by Professor Kenneth A. McClane who is now W.E.B. Du Bois Professor of Literature Emeritus and who said in our 30th anniversary issue, "Rainy Day might well be the longest-lived student publication in the country."  Rainy Day is a prestigious magazine with a long tradition: in our first year, we published a poem by Richard Price, a now-famous novelist and screenwriter (author of "Clockers") and published poems by now famed writers Anselm Hollo, James Bertolino, and Thomas Johnson.

name: RallyCap Sports at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The mission of RallyCap Sports at Cornell is to provide the opportunity for children and young adults with special needs to participate in recreational sports.

name: REAL A Cappella Group
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of Cornell REAL A Cappella shall be to spread Chinese musical culture and create a platform for Chinese students who love singing, performing, music arranging, and video recording to produce music videos, albums, and good-quality live performances.

name: Real Estate Development and Investment Trust at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: CREDIT is an organization committed to enabling undergraduate students with education in the development and investment opportunities within the real estate industry. CREDIT will expose a selective group of committed students to advanced business strategies to maximize their real estate education using both theoretical pedagogy and practical experience.

name: Recreational Fencing Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Provide opportunities for Olympic style fencing in a welcoming and motivational atmosphere.

name: Recreational Tennis Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Our club provides a resource for students to have fun playing tennis outside of a competitive or selective environment. We help students find people to play with or similar skill levels and offer opportunities for beginners to learn and others to improve.

name: Remote Area Medical Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: The purpose of  Remote Area Medical Cornell University Chapter shall be to provide free, high-quality medical, dental, and vision care to those in need regardless of income, identification, or insurance. Doing so will provide Cornell students the opportunity to learn from professionals and patients in a variety of settings across the U.S. and support the care of patients who would not otherwise receive services. Cornell students will take part in non-clinical volunteer roles under the guidance of a team lead, such as checking patients in, translating, and directing patients to treatment.

name: Reserve Tennis Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The Cornell Reserve Tennis Club is intended for intermediate and advanced tennis players who want to play regular tennis with a group of similar players. You are a perfect candidate for this club if you A) played tennis regularly in high school, but now find yourself struggling to make time for tennis or find hitting buddies, B) tried out for the Cornell Tennis Club and didn't make it, or C) played tennis casually in the past and want to improve. We practice multiple times a week and also play several matches against other area colleges each semester. Our goal is to create a small, close community of committed tennis players.

name: Residential Sustainability Leaders
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - AFFILIATION: HRL/WCHS - Residential, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of the Residential Sustainability Leaders shall be to create a culture of sustainability within Cornell's residential communities. This is accomplished by building a bridge between Cornell students and the University in a leadership program focused on increasing knowledge of sustainability. Our team focuses on the advancement of environmental justice principles, peer-to-peer education, program planning and evaluation, and providing a sense of place and belonging to enact meaningful, sustainable change within the Cornell community.

name: Rho Psi Eta Delta Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, AFFILIATION: Professional Fraternity (PFC), PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: Rho Psi Eta is dedicated to fostering a community of like-minded women who are passionate about pursuing a career in a health-related field.

name: Rhythm Gaming at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports
description: The mission of Rhythm Gaming at Cornell shall be to establish a space for the enjoyment and appreciation of rhythm games, both for people who already are entrenched in the scene as well as to help new people get interested and get involved.

name: Ring of Steel: Ithaca
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Ring of Steel: Ithaca is a theatrical stunt group created to bring the "art of stage violence" to Cornell University and Ithaca College students as well as the Ithaca community via teaching and performances.  Members begin their training using bokken (or boken) and then advance to steel swords.  We study rapier, rapier and dagger, broadsword, quarterstaff, and hand-to-hand combat.  The club began in Spring 2003 and is a chapter of the The Ring of Steel Action Theatre located in Ann Arbor, MI.

name: Rise Dance Group
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Rise Dance Group aims to extend the opportunity of dance to all Cornell students who seek to continue their passion for dance. Our group is open to many styles and backgrounds, performing routines in styles such as contemporary, jazz, and many more based on our dancers' interests. We are a close group of friends who not only enjoy dance but are an involved part of the amazing dance community at Cornell.

name: RISEUP (Realizing Integration, Support, and Education for Underserved Populations) at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of RISEUP shall be to empower underserved populations, primarily refugees, immigrants, and asylum seekers, through comprehensive educational initiatives and resources aimed at reducing healthcare disparities.

name: Rock Climbing Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of our organization is to further develop Cornell's recreational and competitive rock climbing community. Through training, we seek to improve our climbing abilities, compete in official USAC competitions, compete in informal local competitions, and take climbing trips to outdoor locations.

name: Romanian Student Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Romanian Student Association at Cornell seeks to bring together international Romanian and Romanian-American students, giving everyone a chance to delve deeper into Romanian culture, history, traditions, and more. Our association aims to bridge the connection between Romanian students and the broader Cornell community while offering support to new students arriving from Romania. RSA promotes cultural awareness and diversity on campus by organizing social, cultural, and educational events that celebrate Romanian heritage. Membership in RSA is open to all Romanian students and to anyone in the Cornell community interested in learning about Romania.

name: Rotaract
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: Rotaract is the college level representative of Rotary International, whose motto is "Service Above Self." We spread their message by providing opportunities for members of the Cornell community to engage in service and volunteering.

name: Running Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Cornell Running Club was founded to promote the sport of running at Cornell. We meet regularly at 5PM in front of Goldwin Smith Hall on weekdays, and in the same location at 4:15PM once daylight saving time ends. The club's aim is to provide a safe, social environment for Cornell community members who would otherwise run alone. Members receive email updates about social activities, competitions, and club proceedings such as elections, and can also join our Slack for more frequent updates. The club welcomes runners of all experience levels and our runs vary from 3 to 10 miles or more at a variety of paces. The purpose of the Club is to promote regular exercise, although many members also choose to compete in races. CRC is a member of National Intercollegiate Running Club Association (NIRCA), so members have the option of participating in intercollegiate competition. Members may also run in a number of local road and cross country races throughout the year.

name: Sabor Latino Dance Ensemble
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Sabor's mission is to represent our Latin American, Caribbean, and African roots through dances as well as our ties to our experience as Latinos in the U.S. Through our annual concert, guest dance performances, and community service, we present the significance of music and dance in our Latino cultures. Sabor has four pillars: Culture, Community, Self-Expression and Family which we foster by doing what we love best which is dancing, bonding with other communities across Cornell's campus and most importantly, educating the community around us.

name: Salsa Pa'Lante
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Salsa ¡Pa’lante! Casineros at Cornell, established in 2004, is dedicated to enhancing and growing the Latin dance community at Cornell University by performing Salsa Casino choreographies and improvised Rueda de Casino demonstrations and by offering Salsa Casino lessons. “Casino” is a Cuban dance commonly identified as “Salsa” or “Cuban Salsa” in the United States. When our organization uses the term “Salsa Casino,” we refer to what Casino means in its original Cuban form while acknowledging its overlap with Salsa and the semantic nuance that exists in the Latin dance community more broadly. Members will dedicate themselves to learning Casino, maintaining its integrity and cultural authenticity to the best of our ability.

name: Scholars in Our Society and Africa
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: Scholars in Our Society and Africa seeks to empower individuals through education. We build scholars to effect change in their immediate society and back home, where they originate. Our mentorship program, community centric after school girls empowerment program, recurring book donation program and project-focused team are some ways we are engaged with the people we serve while providing a conducive environment for growth, personal and professional development for students who want to get involved.

name: Scholars of Finance - Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Inspire character and integrity in the finance leaders of tomorrow.

name: Scholars Working Ambitiously to Graduate
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Scholars Working Ambitiously to Graduate (SWAG) is a mentorship program designed to increase retention and graduation rates among men of color at Cornell University. We achieve this goal through academic enrichment, professional development, and community building.

name: Science Olympiad at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: The purpose of Science Olympiad at Cornell is to organize members of the Cornell community to host an annual Science Olympiad invitational tournament at Cornell University for high school student teams. We also aim to volunteer both at secondary school Science Olympiad competitions in the Southern Tier and New York region as well as in the local community.

name: Seal and Serpent Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Society of the Seal and Serpent was founded to promote good fellowship among certain students of Cornell University, to establish ideals for newly entering students, to bind them together with a selfless spirit both in undergraduate life and life after graduation, and thus raise to a high standard their characters, morals, and scholarship.

name: Sephardi & Mizrahi Student Council
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Spiritual/Religious
description: Our organization represents diverse histories of Sephardic and Mizrahi Jewish backgrounds. Our family stories derive from Spain/Portugal, Algeria, Egypt, Iraq, Iran, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Syria, Tunisia, and Yemen. Therefore, the purpose of the Sephardi & Mizrahi Council shall be to share our stories and values. We hope to celebrate the wisdom and warmth of our Sephardi & Mizrahi traditions and live the example of what these values have to offer to our greater Cornell University community.

name: Sexual Assault Prevention and Safety Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: SAPS’ mission is to create an in-house and inter-house support system for Cornell Greek Life members affected by sexual assault and harassment by institutionalizing interactive education, preventive measures, and communication regarding sexual violence. Namely, SAPS seeks to change the culture in Greek Life through moderated dialogues and discussion forums on the topic of SA, and how to understand, respond, and prevent it. SAPS seeks to create an institutionalized system that students can look to for years to come by passing down knowledge and committee responsibilities to the younger generations of Cornell Greek Life members. SAPS is a two-pronged system. Firstly, each Greek house in the SAPS community has an internal committee. Secondly, roughly once a month, the chairs of each individual SAPS committee meet as representatives of their houses to share updates on their internal meetings and brainstorm ideas on the meeting topic.

name: Shadows Dance Troupe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Shadows Dance Troupe exists to provide Cornell students with the opportunity to dance and perform, with qualifications including experience, merit, enthusiasm, effort, and personal commitment. Shadows holds auditions twice a year: at the beginning of the fall semester and at the beginning of the spring semester. We are always looking for strong, talented dancers. If you are interested in auditioning, please look out for information on our Instagram (@shadowsdancetroupe) or contact one of our co-chairs!

name: Shake Ultimate
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: To field a strong ultimate team that can compete at a regional level while developing the skills and athleticism of all players and to promote a fun and inclusive environment for all.

name: Shimtah at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Performing Arts
description: Our mission is to teach, share, and perform traditional Korean folk music within the Cornell and Ithaca community. We hope to promote the traditional musical aspect of Korean culture, and thus contribute to the cultural and ethnic diversity here at Cornell University. We wish to display the passion and skill of those in Shimtah, and in turn, the reasons for our dedication to this form of music. This club also provides opportunity for students of Korean heritage or those interested in Korean culture to form a social network.

name: Sigma Alpha Sorority
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Animals/Wildlife
description: The objective of this sorority shall be to promote its members in all facets of agriculture and to strengthen the bonds of friendship among them. it is the purpose of its members to strive for achievement in scholarship, leadership, and service, and to further the development of excellence in women pursuing careers in agriculture.

name: Sikh Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Spiritual/Religious
description: Purpose and Aims: 1. The Cornell Sikh Students Association (CSSA) is a multi-purpose organization. It will serve as the voice of Sikh students on campus and allow them the opportunity to practice and express their faith at Cornell. 2. CSSA will serve as a platform for members, visitors and the greater student and public population to learn about and discuss Sikhi, as well as pioneer public awareness and education regarding (but not limited to) Sikhi's beliefs, identity, history and the significance of its festivals. More specifically, CSSA will aim to ensure that over time, the majority of Cornell students can comfortably recognize the Sikh identity and are at the least, familiar with its principal values and beliefs. 3. CSSA will serve as a forum to openly converse about, bring attention and awareness for and brainstorm and implement solutions to any matters representing Sikh interests, including but not limited to Sikhi, Punjab, Sikh politics and issues affecting the Sikh identity. 4. CSSA will strive to form connections, relationships and conferences with other Sikh organizations on an inter-collegiate, national and international level. We will further strive to create connections with Sikh alumni, professionals, or pioneers in any particular field. 5. CSSA will work, often in conjunction with other organizations on campus, to promote tolerance, service, inter-faith dialogue and the vision for a common humanity. 6. The spirit of sewa, or selfless service, will be one of the core values upon which the organization will function.

name: Singapore Students Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: i. To create awareness of Singapore in the Cornell Community. ii. To provide opportunities for recreation and interaction among members and the Cornell community at large.

name: Sitara at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Performing Arts
description: Sitara is Cornell's Premier Bollywood fusion competitive dance team performing in competition, showcases, and events here on campus and across the nation. STA strives to fuse elements of various dance styles and genres including Bollywood, hip hop, Indian Classical, Western Contemporary, and South Indian styles. Our mission is to promote a diverse and inclusive space to explore and celebrate our passion for dance and music.

name: Skateboarding Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: The purpose of the Cornell Skateboarding Club is to organize all members of the Cornell Community who are interested in, already enamored of, or willing to learn about or participate in the sport of skateboarding into a cohesive, active, and vibrant community of skateboarders and skateboarding enthusiasts. We aim to provide equipment and obstacles for seasoned and beginning skateboarders alike, as well as frequent transportation to offcampus skateboarding locales in the Ithaca area and beyond. We also aim to educate folks who want to get into skateboarding but don't know how. One main goal is to film, edit, and produce a video showcasing the vast array of skateboarding talent that Cornell has to offer.

name: Ski and Snowboard Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Active/Recreational: Outdoor Experience
description: To promote recreational involvement in winter sports on campus through trips to local mountains, movie screenings and other events related to winter sports.

name: Slope Media Group
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: As Cornell's multimedia powerhouse, Slope Media Group is a leader in Cornell-related media and entertainment, delivering a creative, student perspective on everything that matters to the Big Red community. Slope is for students, by students.

name: Smart is Strong Foundation, The
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Community Service
description: The Smart is Strong Foundation not only aims to target educational inequality relating to gender in the Greater Ithaca community, but also to use this goal as a vehicle for women's empowerment. As young women who have been empowered by their education at Cornell, we are keen on harnessing the resources of the Ivy League to pay it forward to our community. Our focus in on high school seniors in rural or low-income schools, and are forging community connections to help these young women pay for SAT/ACT tests and college applications. We are also creating a mentorship program to help them navigate the often long and stressful college application process, and fundraising to provide some graduation scholarships at the end of the year to help them in the next step of their journey. It is our hope that our own passion for women's empowerment and education will lead to our advocacy and support for the same in Ithaca area schools, and eventually in our larger international community through fiscal support to foundations such as the Malala Fund.

name: Snail Mail Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Visual Arts
description: The purpose of Snail Mail Club at Cornell shall be to create an environment and provide the supplies for traditional postal mail, centralized as an expression of creativity, care and friendship.

name: Social Business Consulting
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Social Business Consulting Group (SBC) is a non-profit consultancy comprised of Cornell students. Founded in 2007, we provide pro-bono consulting services to further the causes of social entrepreneurs globally, while gaining practical consulting and management experience. The services we offer currently touch on specialties ranging from business development and market-entry strategy to educational curriculum and evaluation studies – and our list of services is continuously expanding. We empower students to affect positive social change, while teaching the skills and nurturing the qualities necessary to be campus leaders and successful in the professional world.

name: Social Enterprise at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: SEC empowers students to build a career in social and environmental impact. We believe that every student brings a crucial perspective that can shape a brighter tomorrow, and keep our resources and events open to all! We hope to serve as a catalyst in three respects: Education. SEC provides educational resources so that students in a variety of professional pursuits can learn about impact investment, social consulting, social entrepreneurship, and social design. Innovation. SEC fosters creativity and supports innovative solutions to social and environmental problems through ideathons, workshops, competitions, and other events. Community. Most importantly, SEC creates community by providing opportunities for students to meet others in our university's diverse student body and learn from a collective pool of knowledge.

name: Social Enterprise Group at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Social Enterprise Group at Cornell (SEGC) is an undergraduate consulting organization at Cornell University dedicated to market-driven solutions to social issues

name: Society for India
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: Society for India is Cornell University's Indian group on-campus and strives to promote Indian and the Indian diaspora's culture and awareness through various events. Our goal is to foster cross-cultural interaction transcending all geographical boundaries as well as providing a strong support system that thrives to provide personal and professional assistance to all Cornell students.

name: Society for Natural Resources Conservation
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Sustainability/Environmental
description: SNRC is a student-run organization committed to creating real environmental impact on campus and the surrounding community by identifying pressing challenges in natural resource conservation, cultivating informed dialogue and practical solutions, and inspiring collective action. SNRC confronts the environmental consequences of human consumption by turning awareness into responsibility and responsibility into action. Through education, advocacy, and direct hands-on engagement, SNRC empowers students across disciplines to protect natural resources, restore shared spaces, and strengthen a culture of sustainability. By connecting environmental knowledge with meaningful action, SNRC works to create visible, lasting change locally, collectively, and with purpose.  “The choices made today will shape the environmental legacy of tomorrow.”

name: Society for the Promotion of Indian Classical Music And Culture Amongst Youth
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Performing Arts
description: It seeks to foster the exchange of traditional Indian values and to generate awareness of the cultural traditions and heritage of India, namely through music and dance. In order to achieve its goals, Cornell Saarang (SPICMACAY chapter) organizes concerts, lectures, demonstrations, informal discussions, and seminars. These are hosted by local chapters of the organization.

name: Society for Women in Business
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Society for Women in Business (SWIB) connects students of all majors with each other and with professional leaders in the business world. We aim to empower talented and intelligent women through education and experience. Through research projects, panels, speaker events, skill-building workshops, and networking events, our goal is to provide our members with the tools to help them advance both personally and professionally.

name: Society of Economic Geologists Student Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: The purpose of the Society of Economic Geologists Student Chapter shall be: 1. To enhance the professional and social interaction between undergraduate and graduate students with interest in the fields of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences pertaining to economic geology; 2. Provide a medium to connect students, with interests in economic geology, to career professionals with the motivation of allowing students to network and explore different career options before graduation; 3. Support the advancement of the science of geology through investigation of mineral resources and mineral deposits, and the application of these investigations to mineral extraction, mining, exploration, and mineral resource appraisal.

name: Soulaan Nation
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: SoulAAn Nation strives to foster cultural unity and understanding among the African American community at Cornell and bring awareness of African American culture to the larger Cornell community. We hope to provide a forum to celebrate the diversity embodied in the African American community through cultural events, educational seminars, publications, and community outreach programs. SoulAAn Nation aims to add a pillar to the broader cultural community, not take away from what’s already established.

name: Sounds of Spirit at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Performing Arts, AFFILIATION: Office of Spirituality and Meaning Making
description: To create a space that embraces Christian values through culturally diverse music production. We hope to create an environment that is welcoming to all, inviting those to appreciation cultural diversity through music, seek meaning, and provide a reminder of home to those familiar to our melodies. The music we create and play will be from all parts of the world, with an emphasis on African diasporic gospel melodies, and incoporate an array of vocals and instrumentation.

name: South Asian Business Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, PROF: Business and Management
description: The organization would provide new members with a semester-long education process to help them explore different fields in business as well as have access to mentorship provided by current SABA students. The organization would also host various speaker, networking, and social events that would connect students with distinguished South Asian Cornell alumni to allow them to learn about career opportunities. The organization would also focus on celebrating South Asian culture through the context of business.

name: Sphinx Head Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: Sphinx Head recognizes Cornell fourth-year undergraduates who have demonstrated respectable strength of character and dedication to leadership and service at Cornell University.

name: Splash at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, PROF: Education/Human Services
description: Splash! seeks to bring under-served, passionate 7th-12th graders to campus to expose them to higher education via courses taught by Cornell undergraduates, graduate students, and faculty members.

name: Spoon University Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink
description: The purpose of Spoon University Cornell Chapter is to create a space where students can explore and share their passion for food through digital media and campus events. We aim to educate, inspire, and connect our community through content that highlights food culture, wellness, and creativity. The goals of this organization are to produce engaging food-related content, teach students about cooking and nutrition, and host events that celebrate diverse cuisines. We also aim to provide hands-on experience in writing, photography, video production, and social media management.

name: Sport Taekwondo at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: We provide Cornell students with the opportunity to learn the martial art of taekwondo and compete in intercollegiate tournaments and other events.

name: Sports Analytics at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: We are a group of students who are passionate about the growing role of analytics in professional and collegiate sports. We want to create an inclusive environment of diverse skill sets where students can research and discuss topics in the field.

name: Sports Business Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, Gaming/Esports, AFFILIATION: ILR
description: The Cornell Sports Business Society is Cornell's premier undergraduate student organization dedicated to involving our members in the sports industry and advancing the world of sports. We aim to engage members in the sports business community by preparing members to be active professionals. Our club supports this mission through six main activities: guest speakers and special events, weekly radio show, semesterly Sports Inc. magazine, club blog, club research department, and media development. Students from all Cornell colleges and majors are welcome to participate and become involved in SBS.

name: Sports Medicine Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of SPORTS MEDICINE CLUB AT CORNELL shall be to expose aspiring medical professionals to unique clinical experiences through Cornell’s Sports Medicine department and therefore encourage a greater understanding of a multidisciplinary healthcare approach and foster a collaborative learning environment that optimizes the care of athletes.

name: Squash Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: The purpose of the Club is to form a community of squash players at Cornell for both recreational and competitive play. We strike a balance between the pressure and time commitment of varsity squash and the limited recreational play time associated with intramural squash. We play throughout the school year at Reis Tennis Center and Belkin Squash courts, where we aim to practice 2 times per week. In addition to practices, we host matches and travel to both club and varsity squash teams.

name: Sri Lankan Students' Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The purpose of this organization is to serve as a community for students of Sri Lankan ethnicity, as well as those interested in Sri Lankan culture. We hope to bring awareness of Sri Lankan culture to the Cornell body.

name: Startup Consulting at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Startup Consulting at Cornell is a student organization that advises startups across a diverse range of industries and functional areas. Through semester-long projects, our members learn valuable strategy consulting skills while driving a tangible impact on startups.

name: STEM Alliance at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Particular groups remain underrepresented within STEM fields at every level, from undergraduate students to professionals. In response, the purpose of the Cornell Underrepresented Students in Physics (CUSP, and later to be STEM Alliance) is to empower students from these backgrounds with community and information resources to ensure academic success and a personal sense of belonging.

name: Steminist Movement at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The Steminist Movement | Cornell seeks to mitigate the STEM gender gap by fostering a community around creating and providing free STEM education to middle school girls as a college chapter of the greater nonprofit The Steminist Movement, Inc.

name: Student Neurodiversity Alliance at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The mission of this organization is to promote acceptance and inclusion of neurodivergent members of the Cornell community, to spread a more nuanced understanding of neurodiversity across campus, and to advocate for policies that will improve the experiences of neurodivergent people at Cornell.  This organization is associated with Neurodiversity @ Cornell and their Neurodiversity Ambassadors program.

name: Student Organ Donation Advocates Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Student Organ Donation Advocates Cornell Chapter is a non-profit community service organization that seeks to lead life-saving organ and tissue donation registration and education efforts on Cornell University's campus and in the greater Ithaca community.

name: Students Demand Action at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Political/Speech/Debate, AFFILIATION: Brooks School
description: Students Demand Action is established for the expressed purpose of organizing students at Cornell to advocate for sensible gun legislation. Through political engagement such as lobby days, letter writing, and public advocacy initiatives, our mission is to end gun violence around the country and to secure a safer future for students around the country.

name: Students for Animals in Shelters
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Animals/Wildlife
description: The mission of SAS is to make a positive impact on our local community and the lives of animals in need. Our primary goal is to fundraise for local animal shelters, ensuring they have the resources necessary to provide proper care and support. In addition to fundraising, we will actively encourage our members with opportunities for hands-on volunteer work at these shelters, allowing students to directly contribute to the welfare of the animals. We will also take on the essential role of advertising shelter animals looking for loving homes, spreading awareness through various platforms to increase adoption rates. We will also collaborate with the Veterinary School’s Shelter Medicine club to connect undergraduates with current vet students interested in shelter medicine. Furthermore, our club serves as a valuable hub to connect students with opportunities in the realm of animal care and shelter medicine. Through our collective efforts, we aim to be a driving force of compassion and positive change for both the students involved, the community, and the animals we support.

name: Students for Justice in Palestine at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Students for Justice in Palestine is an independent student organization at Cornell University that promotes Palestinian national liberation and self-determination through the boycott, divestment and sanction movement and by raising awareness on campus and in the Ithaca community.

name: Students for Sunrise at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Students for Sunrise at Cornell University's mission shall be to engage in fundraising and awareness activities for the Sunrise Association. It is the mission of the Sunrise Association is to bring back the joys of childhood to children with cancer and their siblings worldwide. Sunrise accomplishes this through the creation and oversight of welcoming, inclusive summer day camps, year-round programs, and in-hospital recreational activities, all offered free of charge.

name: Students Providing Aid at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service
description: SPAid@Cornell (Students Providing Aid at Cornell) is dedicated to improving global health by empowering students to construct and distribute kid-friendly first aid kits to underserved communities (under the guidance and supervision of the national chapter). We aim to address healthcare access gaps through collaboration, education, and strategic partnerships, making a tangible impact on global health.

name: Studio: Photography Collective
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Visual Arts
description: Studio is a club at Cornell University with the purpose of assisting independent photographers in getting their work printed, shown in galleries, and published in the club’s yearly magazines. Studio works to foster an environment where photographers can learn from Cornell faculty and each other through critiques, portfolio reviews, and other exercises. Studio encourages photographers of all skill levels to participate in events and submit their work.

name: Sunrise Cornell Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The purpose of Sunrise's Cornell Chapter shall, in alignment with Sunrise National, be to mobilize young people across race and class in the fight against the climate crisis. Together, we will shift public opinion and fight for Green New Deal policies at every level of government, while centering environmental justice, union jobs, racial and economic equity in our work.

name: Super Smash Brothers Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Gaming/Esports
description: The purpose of the Cornell Super Smash Brothers Club is to promote an interest in multiplayer console gaming, especially Super Smash Bros. Melee and Super Smash Bros Ultimate.

name: Surgical Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: The mission of Cornell Surgical Society is to expose Cornell undergraduates to clinical and surgical techniques and practices outside of the classroom setting in hopes of nurturing passionate, inquisitive, and curious minds that will go on to advance the future of the medical field.

name: Sustainability Consulting at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, Sustainability/Environmental
description: We are a student group providing local organizations, small companies, and industry experts with free consultations that meaningfully address modern environmental and social challenges. Our members grow into the next generation of industry leaders by engaging with real-world projects that make a positive impact.

name: Synchronized Skating Club at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: To represent Cornell in the collegiate division at the Eastern Synchronized Team Skating Sectional Championships and compete in regional synchronized skating competitions.

name: T.A.N.G.O.
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: TANGO's mission is to create a space where transgender, agender, nonbinary, genderqueer, and other students with similar and non-cisgender identities and who are questioning their gender identity can meet, get support, and build community.

name: Table Tennis Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: General Purpose: Provide a space and community for members to enjoy and improve in table tennis. Find committed players of all skill levels.

name: Taiko at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural, Performing Arts
description: Yamatai is dedicated to spreading the art and joy of Japanese taiko drumming. Since its founding in 2006, the group has performed at many different venues on the Cornell campus or around Ithaca with the purpose of spreading this art form. Cornell undergraduates of all musical abilities are encouraged to join Yamatai as a testament to the ease with which one can learn taiko. Yamatai aims to inspire and entertain audiences of all walks of life, while exploring the nexus between the contemporary and the traditional.

name: Taiwanese American Student Association at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: TASA strives to promote a better understanding of Taiwanese culture throughout the Cornell Community. It also serves to provide a fun social experience for members through TASA sponsored events.

name: TAMID Group at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: TAMID Group is a nonprofit, apolitical, and non-religious organization that develops the professional skills of undergraduate students through hands-on interaction with the Israeli economy. TAMID’s initiatives are achieved through a comprehensive education curriculum, pro-bono consulting for Israeli startups, capital market investment research, and a summer internship program in Israel. The purpose of TAMID Group at Cornell shall be to facilitate experiential education and cultivate relationships to create a strong, lasting connection to Israel for emerging professionals.

name: Tamil Sangam of Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: "Sangam" means fraternity and friendship in Tamil! Tamil Sangam of Cornell hopes to connect people of Tamil ethnicity and anyone who is interested in the culture and provide a space to gather and share love and appreciation for the Tamil language, art, and culture.

name: Tango at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: To provide opportunities to the graduate student and Cornell community for dancing, learning, and sharing Argentine tango. To raise awareness of tango within these groups, embracing new members. To share the dance's origin and history, as well as Argentine culture in general.

name: Tarana South Asian A Cappella
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Formed in 2011, Tarana brings the warm whiff of chai to Ithaca's frigid winters. As the only South Asian a cappella group at Cornell, Tarana has the unique honor of combining the musical traditions of the East and the West, singing songs by artists from Ariana Grande to Arijit Singh. Solid music, fun performances and good looks have fast made the group a fixture at various shows all around campus.

name: Team Agriculture Education at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Support Agriculture Education: Facilitate workshops, volunteer as judges, and support career technical education across New York state. Promote Education Careers: Work on initiatives such as the Teach Ag Campaign, CALS undergraduate recruitment at conferences, and host high school students to explore Cornell agriculture facilities. Enhance Agriculture Literacy: Utilize the expertise of educators, facilitators, and agriculturalists to improve agriculture literacy in Ithaca and abroad, engaging with a broader audience.

name: TeaTime at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink
description: The purpose of TeaTime at Cornell Club shall be to provide fun and interactive social activities for all students to relax and connect with each other over tea and light snacks. As a community based club, TTC will also engage in educational sessions and charity events that deepens cultural understanding of tea and support the AAPI community. Weekly meetings and changing activities will serve to strengthen bonds between members and Cornell’s social community. The goals of this organization are to promote student mental wellbeing, providing a space for students to relax and connect with fellow peers, participate in community events, and learn interesting information about histories of teas and pastries.

name: TEDxCornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Business and Management
description: TEDxCornell's mission is to deliver a TEDx conference to Cornell annually, featuring speakers ranging from Cornell students and professors to worldwide leaders.

name: Tennis Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: Cornell Club Tennis is a competitive and social coed team of tennis players who practice regularly and compete against other university club teams. We are also the official Cornell team for USTA Tennis on Campus.  Practices consist of match play and technique improvement usually three nights a week. Attendance of about one practice a week or more is required. Cornell Club Tennis has traveled all the way from New York City to Arizona to Florida to compete against other teams in the past. We are looking for players who have played competitively in the past (almost all current members played on their high school tennis teams) and still enjoy the sport! The team aims to maintain a roster of approximately 20 women and 20 men. Tryouts are held at the beginning of the fall semester.

name: Teszia Belly Dance Troupe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Teszia Belly Dance Troupe was started at Cornell University in 1996 to provide an outlet for troupe members to join together in celebration of their collective interest in the oriental (belly) dance art form. We encourage troupe members to develop their dance skills by providing instruction and regular practices, as well as performance opportunities, all of which culminate in our annual Spring Shimmy dance show. Fill out this form to join: https://cglink.me/2ee/s95776

name: The Advocacy Project from Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The mission of the Advocacy Project is to spread access to a quality education in persuasion, argumentation, and advocacy, available to anybody with an internet connection

name: The Alt. Protein Project at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Food/Drink, PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of THE ALT. PROTEIN PROJECT AT CORNELL shall be to create an inclusive space for research and interest in the alternative protein field among all Cornellians, encouraging a student-led movement towards addressing sustainability, food insecurity, and nutrition.

name: The Animation Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Visual Arts
description: I have always felt that animation has been devalued as a legitimate art form, and my ultimate desire is to shift people’s long-standing negative mindsets, perceived limitations, and even prejudices regarding what animation can be and do. I wish to establish this club to increase awareness in the often unnoticed artistry and capabilities of the medium of animation. I want to provide an opportunity for students to participate in the production of animation projects to experience firsthand the tremendous potential for the medium to express the raw and true emotion of the human spirit. Establishing a club at Cornell University would provide a unique opportunity.

name: The CallbaXX a Cappella
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: The mission of this group is to provide members with an outlet of musical expression, a place to grow in their musical abilities, and a community of individuals with a mutual love of singing, as well as provide entertainment to the Cornell community with a new perspective on a cappella that focuses on the fun and quirky side of making music without instruments.

name: The Chavurah at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: To promote a communal Jewish living and learning community at Cornell aimed at advancing progressive Jewish cultural, educational, and political principles through religious practice.

name: The Cornell Diplomat
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Political/Speech/Debate
description: The Cornell Diplomat is an international issues-focused magazine that strives to explore the Cornell community's diverse global perspectives.

name: The Cornell Review
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: The purpose of The Cornell Review shall be to provide insightful political analysis and news related to issues facing the Cornell community, the United States, and the world, and to provide centrists, classical liberals, conservatives, right-of-center populists, and libertarians alike an opportunity to publish well-constructed arguments.

name: The Cornell University Student Chapter of the American Civil Liberties Union
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: The ACLU is committed to educating students about their legal rights and freedoms, while providing support for social justice advocacy efforts on campus.

name: The Disruptive Collective
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: Our mission is to reinvent the way people see contemporary dance and to use dance to embody stories bigger than ourselves. By tackling societal and self issues through dance, we will use the collective as an outlet. Through choreography classes, improvisation sessions, artistic photoshoots, and performances, we hope to invigorate ourselves and our audiences for higher purposes.

name: The Episcopal Church at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The Episcopal Church at Cornell (ECC) is a community dedicated to knowing God in all the many ways God speaks to and through us in our daily activities, our studies, and throughout the course of our lives. We are an inclusive, questioning community with Christ at our core. ECC is a gathering place: a chaplaincy in which the contribution of every body–of every race, every gender, every religious background, every sexuality, every academic discipline–is welcomed and celebrated. Student, faculty, staff, alum, or none-of-the-above, we worship together, eat together, and support one another. ECC is a place of exploration. We are called to know God through the unique vessels of our lives, and we strive to provide meaningful spiritual and pastoral care to any seeking student, as well as facilitate small group programing that reflects the real needs and interests of the Cornell community. ECC is a Church. We are a reflection of the unfolding and many-membered Body of Christ: inclusive of all, willing grow, and serious in our commitment to love. In the words of the Iona Community, “we invite you to be known and to be fed here.”

name: The HeARTbeat at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, Health/Wellbeing
description: The HeARTbeat at Cornell is a student-run healthcare publication centered around expressing interdisciplinary aspects of medicine and healthcare through the creative voices of students, faculty, and other professionals. This publication provides an imaginative outlet for any members of the community who want to express their experiences and perspectives on various discussions related to health, such as a biological, anthropologic, and even historical perspective through a creative lens. Transforming thoughts, memories, and emotions into powerful representations of health, The HeARTbeat at Cornell serves as a way to create a deeper connection of the ingenuity and interdisciplinary nuance that exists within science.

name: The Insurance Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: a) The purpose of this club shall be to advance the intellectual and professional interests of students who seek to understand and engage with the insurance, reinsurance, and risk management industries. b) It shall hold regular meetings and organize events to bridge the gap between students and the insurance industry through speaker panels, career discussions, and experiential learning workshops designed to promote understanding of insurance, risk, and financial protection mechanisms. c) It shall provide members with opportunities to explore careers in underwriting, brokerage, reinsurance, claims, and risk analysis while fostering the development of analytical, interpersonal, and ethical decision-making skills. d) It shall strive to be recognized as a meaningful and respected organization within the Cornell community, building lasting connections with alumni, industry professionals, and related academic disciplines. e) It shall encourage all members to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and ethical conduct in all academic and organizational activities. In summary, this club is a student-led organization that hopes to share knowledge of the insurance and risk management industries, connecting students with professionals, fostering industry literacy, and preparing members for competitive careers within the industries.

name: The Lebanese Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: To have an organization in which the Lebanese culture can be researched, discussed, and celebrated by Lebanese and non-Lebanese members alike.

name: The MergerSight Group at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Our vision is to build an international community of finance students, providing concise reports of global M&A transactions; hence enabling students all over the world to stay updated about recent deals.

name: The Progressives
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Political/Speech/Debate
description: The mission statement of The Progressives shall be as follows: To advance leftist causes on the campus level, community level, and beyond.

name: The Responsible Artificial Intelligence Network
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: RAIN provides opportunities for students to participate in projects, debates, and speaker series, aiming to create a community of thoughtful, informed Cornellians who can shape the future of artificial intelligence in a way that promotes the well-being of all.

name: The Shakespeare Troupe at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Our mission is to make Shakespeare a more accessible art form to the general public. Traditionally considered to be an elite form of theatre only palatable to white, middle class audiences, Shakespeare often seems out of reach or dated to most undergraduate students.  The purpose, then, of this troupe is to demonstrate that a) Shakespeare's writing is still as relevant as ever and that b) his work can truly be enjoyed by any audience. This organization is a registered student organization of Cornell University.

name: The Skits
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: The Skits is Cornell's Original Sketch Comedy group! Each year, we put on several all original sketch comedy shows, entirely written, directed, produced, and performed by our members. In addition, we spread laughter across campus in the form of many free, small-venue performances.

name: The Swift Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Build community with other individuals who admire the singer/songwriter skills of Taylor Swift.

name: The Thomistic Institute at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The mission of TI@CU is to foster learning and understanding of the Catholic intellectual tradition with an emphasis on the teachings of St. Thomas Aquinas, and to bring it into meaningful discourse with modern society. To this end, TI@CU organizes lectures, reading groups and social events. The target audience/member is any Cornell community member with an interest in the above.

name: The TRIBECA Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: TRIBECA is a student-led organization dedicated to empowering transfer students pursuing careers in investment banking, consulting, and accounting. Our mission is to bridge the gap for transfer students by providing tailored professional development, industry exposure, and a supportive community. We strive to equip our members with the tools, resources, and network necessary to compete and succeed in top-tier business careers.

name: The Undergraduate Law & Society Review at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: We started the Review to provide students with an outlet for reasoned discourse on the legal, economic, and social challenges confronting our generation. We are confident that this conversation starts, first and foremost, with the right kind of writing. We are confident that our culture, one that prides itself on both objectivity and ambiguity, will help us establish the Review as one of Cornell's premier forums for legal discourse, critical writing, and academic fervor.

name: The Undergraduate Student Chapter for the Center of Health Equity at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Health/Wellbeing
description: The Cornell Center For Health Equity Undergraduate Student Chapter (CCHEq) aims to immerse Cornell's undergraduate students in health equity topics and research beyond traditional academic settings, fostering a generation of future health professionals who are deeply informed about and committed to addressing health disparities. By organizing educational initiatives such as mini-lecture series, community outreach, guest lectures, and social media campaigns, CCHEq provides a platform for students to explore the "hidden curriculum" in medicine and the pivotal social determinants of health. This mission is rooted in the broader vision of CCHEq to not only raise awareness but also to cultivate passionate, caring, and inquisitive minds ready to advance the field of medicine and medical education with equity at the forefront. Through these efforts, CCHEq seeks to build a foundation for equitable healthcare practices among the undergraduate community at Cornell University.

name: The Wardrobe
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Community Service, Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Wardrobe is a social entrepreneurship organization that provides free professional attire to all members of the Cornell community. We believe the inability to acquire professional clothing should not be a barrier to an individual's pursuit of professional opportunities.

name: The Washington Forum on India at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Political/Speech/Debate
description: The Washington Forum on India seeks to bridge the gap in understanding Indian economics and politics within the United States. The organization provides a platform for students to analyze India’s role in global affairs, promote informed discussion, and advance academic and professional engagement with issues shaping U.S.-India relations. At Cornell, WFI aims to encourage thoughtful dialogue, cross-cultural understanding, and leadership among students interested in India’s growing influence in the world. Through speaker events, research writing workshops, and pro-bono consulting projects for small and medium-sized enterprises operating within the U.S.–India business corridor, WFI motivates students to apply their skills to real-world challenges from exploring market dynamics and regulatory environments to analyzing sectoral trends that drive bilateral cooperation and sustainable economic growth.

name: The Women's Network
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The mission of this organization is to encourage women to be supportive of each other and provide opportunities to network with women of all ages. The overarching purpose of The Women's Network initiative is to inspire and empower young women with the hope that they will pay this support forward and help young women in the future. The mission is also to help build more confidence in young women and encourage them to pursue what interests them. The intended impact of this organization is to build a community filled with passionate, ambitious women who will be encouraged to be more supportive of fellow women and be a more inclusive body. The services provided by TWN include networking events, speakers panels, workshops, and opportunities to pursue internships and leadership roles like campus ambassadors, peer mentors, and blog writers.

name: The Yellow Paint Society
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Visual Arts
description: The mission of our organization is to create an environment and community that advocates for the exploration of intersections between social justice and mental health through art. We aim to promote the mental well-being of our members and the Cornell Community as a whole. Using the therapeutic properties of art, our club aims to create a space where members can de-stress, reflect on their mental health and well-being, and support and encourage other members.

name: Theme Park Engineering Group
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Engineering
description: To create a group where those interested in advancing their interests in the Theme Park Industry may gather with students of a similar mindset pursue their paths towards involvement in this industry.  Through competition, outreach, and experiences members will gather knowledge on what work in the Theme Park industry is like and will start building the necessary skills to enter the industry.

name: Thread Magazine
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: Thread is Cornell's largest fashion, art, and culture publication. As a completely student-run publication, Thread is a conglomeration of student-made photography, styling, design, and writing. It is published every semester and aims to showcase the unique and diverse talents of individuals within the Cornell community through its attention to high quality and compelling, visual storytelling.

name: Top Gun Laparoscopic Skills & Suturing Interest Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing
description: Our mission is to promote student interest in the fields of technology, research, medicine, and minimally invasive surgery (MIS). It is important that this be established early in the student's career at the university level to prepare them for future medical and academic endeavors. It seeks to place the students in proximity with technology that will lead to an increase in hand-eye coordination, fine motor skills, and will provide a platform for them to innovate. Ultimately, its goal is to train future leaders that will move humankind forward.

name: Touchtones All Female A Cappella
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Our organization's purpose is to create music and improve our skills as musicians in the Cornell community.

name: Track & Field Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive
description: CORNELL TRACK & FIELD CLUB [CTFC] CORNELLIANS, WELCOME ONE AND ALL to a great team that gathers together to keep in shape via the awesome sport of Track and Field. Whether you are here just to get into shape or to train to compete in meets, YOU HAVE A PLACE IN THIS CLUB! -> Practice time: 7:30 PM Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in Barton Hall -> No tryouts to join the club! You may join at anytime throughout the academic year. Just bring your energy and we'll supply the workout! -> Track-style workouts organized for you, including sprints, distance, jumping, and hurdling! Your feedback and workout ideas are encouraged to improve and diversify our workout repertoire -> Approximately 2 meets per month starting in December in both Barton Hall and off-campus peer universities -> We will build up everyone's fitness before we hit the ground running with our track workouts!

name: Triathlon Club at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Competitive, Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive
description: Cornell Triathlon, founded in 2014 and based in Ithaca, NY, has the mission of furthering the sport of triathlon at Cornell University.

name: Ukulele Club at Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Performing Arts
description: Ukulele Club at Cornell University exists to promote the study and performance of ukulele music. We focus on learning basic techniques and enhancing the skills of the members. We intend to perform and bring ukulele music to the Cornell campus as well as the surrounding Ithaca area.

name: Unconscious Design Vanguard
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action, Visual Arts, AFFILIATION: College of Architecture Art and Planning
description: In the UDV we aim to revive unconscious principles. These principles like symmetry, mathematical proportionality, and harmony immemorially have been understood to underlie beauty. These principles lead to our liking of things without clear rationale. These principles were the foundation of a design based education since before antiquity. Only around one hundred years ago did these fully fall out of education. By reintegrating these principles into students’ design education, we can thereby rekindle beauty in our surroundings.

name: Undergraduate Asia Business Society at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Undergraduate Asia Business Society at Cornell (CUABS) is a global network of highly motivated student leaders who seek to impact Cornell and the greater business community. To achieve this vision, we empower our members by building their professional and leadership skills and fostering a tight-knit community centered around our shared values: leadership, family, and excellence. CUABS also has an actively growing alumni network of friends working in a variety of companies and disciplines, from McKinsey & Co to Microsoft.

name: Undergraduate Human Capital Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: Cornell Undergraduate Human Capital Association is the Cornell undergraduate chapter of the Human Capital Association at Cornell. HCA believes people are the most critical component to any organization and is dedicated to connecting our members with leaders who share this belief. Through educational and professional engagements, we empower our members to view the world of work through a human capital lens.

name: Undergraduate Humanities Review at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media
description: The purpose of the Undergraduate Humanities Review at Cornell shall be to platform undergraduate classicists, historians, philosophers, anthropologists, and scholars of the liberal arts—to disseminate the humanities. Grounded in epistemic and methodological pluralism, the review engages rigorous interdisciplinary inquiry informed by the normative impulses animating humanist thought: Intellectual humility, fidelity to empiricism, abiding ethical concern.

name: Undergraduate International Law Review at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Publication/Media, PROF: Law
description: The purpose of the Undergraduate International Law Review at Cornell shall be to foster a comprehensive understanding of international and comparative law among undergraduate students at Cornell University through scholarly research, and writing. Our mission is to provide a platform that empowers students to critically engage with and evaluate the role of international law in addressing global legal challenges

name: Unicycling Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Performing Arts
description: Reduce stress, socialize, and achieve a more healthy Work Life BALANCE

name: Urban Herbin (Urban Ethnobotany Club)
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Health/Wellbeing, Sustainability/Environmental
description: Our mission is to be able to teach members about the land we are inhabiting and how indigenous practices that are often overlooked can be utilized by everyday people to lead healthier lives. We strive to teach our community how to create greener spaces in unconventional areas like their own apartments and rooftops. Ultimately, we want to also teach our community about how indigenous medicinal plants can be grown in mundane environments to benefit their lives.

name: Vaccination Conversations with Scientists - Cornell Student Chapter
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Advocacy/Social Justice/Action
description: Vaccination Conversations with Scientists - Cornell Student Chapter is an outreach initiative promoting vaccine uptake by connecting Cornell University students (scientists-in-training) with community members to have conversations about the science behind vaccines. We attend training, phone banking, and community event canvassing events organized by the local organization Vaccination Conversations with Scientists as well as propose our own vaccine education initiatives on campus to disseminate information about upcoming vaccine clinics, the latest research and recommended public health guidelines.

name: Varsity Botany Club Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Sustainability/Environmental
description: The mission of Varsity Botany Club shall be to inspire an appreciation for the value of botany in our world, to develop knowledge of diverse botanical topics, to promote the pursuit of excellence in botanical science, and to explore the interconnectedness of biological life on Earth

name: VASA DEI at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Active/Recreational: Noncompetitive, Performing Arts
description: The purpose of VASA DEI shall be to unite all believers at Cornell as one body of Christ, through the gift of dance, to be vessels of His good news to bring praise and glory all to God.

name: Venture Capital at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management
description: The Cornell Venture Capital Club connects Cornell students and entrepreneurs with the dynamic world of venture capital. We provide Cornell undergraduates with the valuable and unique opportunity to work directly with leading venture capital firms; we host prominent entrepreneurs and venture capitalists as guest lecturers on Cornell's campus; we also provide resources for budding student entrepreneurs. Our flagship VC Internship Program provides high-potential Cornell undergraduates with the unparalleled opportunity to learn about the venture capital industry by working directly with leading VC firms through projects about their respective investment theses.

name: Ventures Accelerated
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Business and Management, PROF: Software/Coding/Programming
description: To bring together students to build stellar companies. To build a strong community filled with student entrepreneurs that will support, guide, and learn from one another. To help students passionate about start-ups succeed in bringing their ideas to reality. To connect student companies with prominent Venture Capital Firms, Accelerators, and mentors to further grow and scale their  companies.

name: Vessels of Honor at Cornell
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Spiritual/Religious
description: The mission of Vessels of Honor is to create a space for anyone within the Cornell and local Ithaca community to dive into the Bible as the complete, divine truth (John 17:17), build one another up in fellowship (Ephesians 4:16), and pursue Christ as the way, the reality, and the life (John 14:6). The club is open to anyone regardless of background, and no prior experience of Christ is required. Our meetings are centered around the ministry of believers who came before us, and through their work, laid a strong foundation for us to understand God's eternal purpose.

name: Veteran's Social Club
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - Student Groups for Student Services
description: The Mission of the Veterans Social Club is to offer a stress-free environment for veterans and their supporters; to congregate and socialize without politics, religion, or other issues that cause emotional stress.

name: Vietnamese Student Association
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - International/Multicultural
description: The Cornell Vietnamese Association is an organization that promotes awareness, appreciation, and education of Vietnamese culture, heritage, and traditions within the organization as well as throughout the Cornell and Ithaca communities.

name: Viticulture and Enology Club, Cornell University
category: Undergrad General Student Organization (GSO) - PROF: Science/Healthcare
description: The purpose of CUVEC shall be to enrich the Cornell Viticulture and Enology experience through practice in and exploration of diverse topics within the wine industry and other allied industries in order to further develop the specialization of students.

name: Voices of Equity Cornell Chapter
